about: Public features a library crate's README describes that no feature contract under harness/features/ compares with its reference, by crate: each by a short stable name, the public items it is reached through and what a comparison would need. A crate listed with no features was reviewed and has none; a crate not listed is not reviewed yet. A feature leaves its list when a contract compares it. `cargo xtask check-design` checks the list and holds the count per crate to harness/gate-exceptions.json, so a feature left uncompared is recorded as visibly as a loosened gate.

triergon-ass.name: renderer-settings
triergon-ass.needs: ass-render fixtures rendered with each setting changed from its default, against libass configured with the same values

triergon-font.name: store
triergon-font.needs: a worker operation whose output depends on what the store keeps under its budget; no reference exposes an equivalent cache

triergon-framing.name: nal-length-prefixed-reading
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation reading length-prefixed NAL units from MP4 and Matroska samples, folded against the reference's units; only Annex B reading is compared (raw-annex-b, mpegts-access-units)

triergon-framing.name: nal-configuration-inputs
triergon-framing.needs: a corpus of Annex B and declared parameter sets with a reference projection of the configuration each gives and of its Annex B form

triergon-framing.name: hevc-hvcc-prefix-inspection
triergon-framing.needs: a corpus of whole and truncated hvcC records with a reference view of the fields the prefix inspection reports

triergon-framing.name: hevc-record-writing
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation writing hvcC records and their Annex B form, compared byte for byte with the reference's conversion of the same samples

triergon-framing.name: av1-obu-reading
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation reading OBUs incrementally, folded against the reference's OBUs of the same temporal units

triergon-framing.name: vp9-configuration
triergon-framing.needs: a VP9 corpus with a reference view of the configuration the parser reads

triergon-framing.name: aac-configuration-views
triergon-framing.needs: a reference view of AudioSpecificConfig at both extents and of the decoder configuration and channel views it gives

triergon-framing.name: aac-adts-buffer-parsing
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation parsing ADTS frames from complete buffers, compared with the reference's frames and headers

triergon-framing.name: eac3-bsi
triergon-framing.needs: an E-AC-3 corpus with a reference view of every bitstream information field

triergon-framing.name: dts-core-inspection
triergon-framing.needs: a feature contract and worker operation for what the opt-in dts_packet_corpus test compares with the pinned FFmpeg outside the gate

triergon-framing.name: dts-core-extent
triergon-framing.needs: a reference of each core frame's declared extent over the DTS corpus

triergon-framing.name: dts-packings
triergon-framing.needs: 14-bit and packed DTS inputs with a reference of the normal frames they carry

triergon-framing.name: dts-reference-trace
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation that runs this comparison projection against the reference

triergon-isobmff.name: segment-indexes
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation reading sidx, tfra and mfro boxes, compared with the reference's segment and fragment index entries

triergon-isobmff.name: quicktime-pcm-sound
triergon-isobmff.needs: a corpus of version 0 QuickTime sound descriptions with a reference view of their fields and PCM samples

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-pcm-packets
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation grouping QuickTime PCM samples into packets, folded against the reference's packets; tests check recorded reference output in tests/fixtures/pcm-v0

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-run-recovery
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker profile running run and direct recovery and physical reads against the reference's recovered packets; --recover-regular-tables runs description recovery only

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-track-seek
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation seeking one track on its own against the reference; compared only as the per-track step of GlobalSeekJob (isobmff-seek)

triergon-isobmff.name: source-seek-planning
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation planning seeks to a sample ordinal with a caller's preroll and looking up composition times, against the reference; compared only inside MovieSourceSeekPlanner range plans (isobmff-seek)

triergon-isobmff.name: dts-core-signalling
triergon-isobmff.needs: a corpus of DTS sample entries with the reference's verdict on their core signalling

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-encoded-views
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation projecting the metadata, recovery and dependency views of encoded entries against the reference; tests check recorded reference output in tests/fixtures

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-reference-trace
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation that runs these comparison projections against the reference; tests check recorded reference output only
